messages.subject: Error message "No rows to aggregate"
parts:
Hi,
I tried to start using MSStats as an external tool from Skyline. While I can do Group Comparisons within the Skyline software, I repeatedly get the following error message when I use MSStats:

Error in aggregate.data.frame(mf[1L], mf[-1L], FUN = FUN, ...) :
  no rows to aggregate
 Can't finish analysis.

When I look for the respective csv-file it is present and contains data.

Am I missing something?

Many thanks in advance!
Joerg

messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: Error message "No rows to aggregate"
parts:
Hi, Joerg,

I just saw your post over on the Skyline support board, where you mentioned that you were using small molecules.
MSstats does not work with small molecules. The reason for this is that the MSstats Input report relies on the "PeptideModifiedSequence" column which is blank for small molecules.
I am not sure whether any sort of workaround exists for this, or whether there are plans to support small molecules in the future.
